what_changed.collector_capture: `capture_same_day_close` in deploy/collector/collector_stack/runner.py + `capture-close` CLI + systemd pantheon-collector-close.{service,timer}: Mon-Fri Asia/Taipei 14:40,14:50,15:00..16:50 every 10 min and 17:00; each of TWSE/TPEx price-history sources is requested once per trading day for today's date (one connection, >=min_interval_seconds=5 between the two), a per-source ledger under /data/state/same-day-close skips captured days, an unpublished page/failed fetch exits 2 (SuccessExitStatus=2) and the next tick retries until 17:00. Outside the window, weekends and known holidays do nothing. Existing 6-hourly timers unchanged.
what_changed.newest_first_pull: CollectorBundleAdapter newest-first mode (automatic for tw_price_daily when the adapter's pull cadence is <= 3600 s, i.e. the 30 min price-history definitions; daily cadence keeps plain cursor order): the newest-TRADE-DATE bundle (run id backfill-/close-<date>) is verified and returned ahead of the oldest-first cursor sweep with the remaining per-pull cap going to the sweep; its delivered offset is persisted (latest_priority.json) so a >1000-row day is delivered across pulls and not repeated. Price-history cadence 86400 -> 1800 s and per-pull cap 1000 (the fetch.max_records ceiling). Host staleness is still judged against the collector's own cadence from status.json.
what_changed.lineage: collector price rows now carry metadata.collector_close {provisional:true, official:false, collector_source_id, exchange_endpoint, bundle_sha256, bundle_run_id, trade_date}, symbol_canonical NNNN.TWSE|TPEX and market TW (same identity as the official OpenAPI row). Rows without complete lineage (collector source, https exchange website host, 64-hex digest) never enter the snapshot projection.
what_changed.admission: LatestMarketSnapshot lineage lists collector_close entries; evaluate_taiwan_market_freshness admits a newest close that is collector-relayed only with complete lineage (otherwise market_input_stale, never a non-official-lineage pause). All other rules (13:30 session close, receipt after close, no newer closed session, calendar evidence) are unchanged.
what_changed.official_wins: LatestMarketSnapshotStore._merge_point matches on the Taipei trade date: a collector row is dropped when an official row exists for that date; an official row replaces a provisional one and compare_close records agree or a typed collector_close_mismatch (kept=official) in snapshot.close_reconciliation, exposed in the public snapshot readback as close_reconciliation {compared, agreed, mismatched, mismatches}. tw_close_reconcile.py holds the shared pure helpers.
what_changed.preflight: controller_worker._validate_terminal_readback: when BOTH collector price-history connectors report a latest record with valid lineage for the same session and that session's 13:30 close has passed, the official market connector's freshness_not_accepted and market_input_stale are re-evaluated against the collector close and accepted.
what_changed.unchanged: OpenAPI tw_price_daily selection/official truth, ingest_operations.py, paper_signal_producer.py, hosted activation (STRAT-DATASRC-HOSTED-ACCEPT-20261110), no synthetic data; without collector data every path behaves as before. scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh needed no change (collector_steady_pull mode already exists).
